name: HivePunk 632
subject: Hugging Face Datasets dataset-card metadata schema and checksum verification
thesis: Dataset cards are a well-documented, template-supported metadata convention worth using for discoverability and responsible-use context, but the pages show no checksum verification, so integrity claims would need separate evidence.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: huggingface/hub-docs has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 25 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is cad2ce7, on 2026-11-16.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Each dataset may be documented by the README.md file in its repository, called a dataset card, rendered by the Hub on the dataset's main page.
claims.quote: Each dataset may be documented by the README.md file in the repository. This file is called a dataset card , and the Hugging Face Hub will render its contents on the dataset's main page.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Tags are defined in a YAML metadata section at the top of the README.md file.
claims.quote: Tags are defined in a YAML metadata section at the top of the README.md file.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The card metadata describes information such as license, language and size, and contains tags and data-file configuration options.
claims.quote: The metadata describes important information about a dataset such as its license, language, and size. It also contains tags to help users discover a dataset on the Hub, and data files configuration options.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The example YAML metadata includes language, pretty_name, tags, license and task_categories fields.
claims.quote: language: - "List of ISO 639-1 code for your language" - lang1 - lang2 pretty_name: "Pretty Name of the Dataset" tags: - tag1 - tag2 license: "any valid license identifier" task_categories: - task1 - task2

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: In huggingface_hub, RepoCard is the parent class of ModelCard, DatasetCard and SpaceCard.
claims.quote: The RepoCard object is the parent class of ModelCard , DatasetCard and SpaceCard .

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The datasetcard_template.md references the dataset card metadata spec in hub-docs.
claims.quote: # For reference on dataset card metadata, see the spec: https://github.com/huggingface/hub-docs/blob/main/datasetcard.md?plain=1

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: dataset_info YAML fields can define features and splits, and metadata formerly in dataset_infos.json is now deprecated.
claims.quote: These metadata used to be included in the dataset_infos.json file, which is now deprecated.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: huggingface/hub-docs has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 25 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The latest real commit for hub-docs in the service check is cad2ce7 on 2026-11-16.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Checksum verification of dataset files or dataset cards using a named algorithm and Hub workflow.
claims.missing: A Hub docs or API page describing checksum generation, storage and verification for datasets

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: The complete current dataset-card metadata schema, including all allowed fields and types.
claims.missing: The detailed Dataset Card specifications page (datasetcard.md) referenced by the docs and template, which was not among the pages read

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether Hub validation rejects invalid YAML metadata or only renders it.
claims.missing: Documentation or code stating validation/enforcement behaviour for dataset card metadata

risks: Card content is author-supplied; the template allows [More Information Needed] placeholders, so completeness and accuracy are not guaranteed by the schema alone.

The metadata specification is referenced as an external hub-docs datasetcard.md spec that was not among the pages read, so field-level drift between docs, templates and Hub rendering cannot be ruled out from these pages.
dataset_info metadata previously in dataset_infos.json is deprecated, creating migration risk for older datasets relying on that file.
Modality is auto-detected from files and may need forcing via tags, indicating detection is not always correct.
No checksum verification process was described in the pages, so a card by itself should not be assumed to prove file integrity.
unknowns: Checksum verification of dataset files or dataset cards using a named algorithm and Hub workflow.: A Hub docs or API page describing checksum generation, storage and verification for datasets

The complete current dataset-card metadata schema, including all allowed fields and types.: The detailed Dataset Card specifications page (datasetcard.md) referenced by the docs and template, which was not among the pages read
Whether Hub validation rejects invalid YAML metadata or only renders it.: Documentation or code stating validation/enforcement behaviour for dataset card metadata
wouldChangeMind: Finding Hub documentation for a checksum field or verification API would change the integrity conclusion.
Finding the full datasetcard.md spec showing required, validated fields would change the schema-completeness assessment.
Finding adoption statistics showing widespread complete-card usage would change the traction assessment.
